title: Getting your console ready for OpenPak News
body: Three things put OpenPak News on your console. First, re-run the OpenPak installer and re-select your network: its DNS redirects now include the News host, and older installs do not have that entry. Second, install both News patches from the probe: the verification-key patch with the R button, and the token patch with D-pad Right. Third, reboot after each change; patches apply at boot. Keep OpenPak DNS enabled whenever you read News, because the patches are not hostname-selective and Nintendo endpoints will not answer these requests.
